EMPLOYEES’ PROVIDENT FUND ORGANISATION
(Head Office)
NOTIFICATION

New Delhi, the 8th October, 2015

HRM-11/22(1)2009/DR Quota.—In exercise of the powers delegated by Central Board, Employees’
Provident Fund under Sub-section 7(a) of Section 5 D of the Employees’ Provident Fund and Miscellaneous Provisions
Act, 1952 (19 of 1952), the Central Provident Fund Commissioner, after consultation and with the approval of Govt. of
India, Ministry of Labour & Employment and Union Public Service Commission, hereby amends the Enforcement
Officer/Accounts Officer Recruitment Rules, 2009, namely:—

L Short title and commencement:

(1) These rules may be called the Employees’ Provident Fund Organization (Enforcement Officer/Accounts
Officer) (Amendment) Recruitment Rules, 2015.

(2) They shal? come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette,
2. Num! f el

The number of posts, its classification and scale of pay attached thereto shall be as specified in columns 2 to 4
of the schedule annexed to these Rules.

Method of recruitment, age limit snd other qualifications:

The method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications and other matters relating thereto shall be us specified in
columns 5 to 13 of the said Schedule.

4. Disqualificaton.—-No Person:
(@) Who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living.
OR
(b) Who having a spouse fiving has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person;
Shall be eligible for appointment to the said post:

Provided that the Central Board may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal Jaw
applicable to such person and the other party to the murri age and that there are other grounds for so doing,
exempt any person from the operation of this rule.

5. Power to relax:

Where the Central Board is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient to do so, it may, by order and for
Teasons to be recorded in writing, and in consultation with the Govt. of India, Ministry of Labour & Employment and
Union Public Service Commission relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of
persons. :
6. avin

Nothing in these rules shall affect reservations, relaxation of age limit and other concessions required to be
provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, Ex- Servicemen and other special categories of persons in
accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time in this regard.

(B) Data Botry Operator(Grade ‘C") with three years regular

(C) Social Security Assistants / Stenographers / Data Entry

service in PB-1 Rs. 5200-20200 with Grade Pay of Rs. 2400
and serving in the respective regions.

NOTE 1: Promotion shall be subject to successful completion of
two to four weeks of training as devised by EPFO.

Provided that those persons who have not completed training for

considered subject to the condition that the required taining will be
completed within one year of the date of meeting of DPC.

NOTE 2: Those persons who are due to retire within two years
may be exempted from completion of such training for promotion.
